title: Small commits and precise diffs
outcome: Separate changes with partial staging and verify exactly what a commit will contain.
cue: Two diffs. One reason per commit.
version: Modern Git; check git --version for command availability

exercises.title: Find and fix the bug
exercises.prompt: A fix passes tests locally but fails after commit because its helper change was unstaged. Explain why and propose a safer verification step.

exercises.title: Change one condition
exercises.prompt: You need to switch tasks with a new untracked file. What do you check before stashing?

trace.title: Mixed edits
trace.detail: A good commit captures one reviewable reason for change. Files are not always the right unit: one file may contain a bug fix and an unrelated cleanup. Partial staging chooses hunks or lines for the proposed snapshot.

trace.title: Follow the middle steps
trace.detail:
Partial staging updates only the chosen parts of the index. The file in your editor can still contain both changes. Unstaging copies the HEAD version back into the index while keeping the working edit for this command form.

Before claiming a staged commit passes tests, inspect it in a disposable clean checkout or worktree after committing locally. Do not run a destructive cleanup on your active work just to get a clean test environment.

trace.title: Check the result
trace.detail: git add . can include an unrelated change or secret. Ignore rules do not remove a secret from existing history. Stash pop can conflict and should not be treated as a guaranteed clean restore.

recallPrompt: Without notes: Separate changes with partial staging and verify exactly what a commit will contain. Give a concrete failure example.
